name: Mayana Geathers
tagline: Feminist therapist, writer, and creator of original guided meditations.
_comment_urls: External destinations. The /contact link on Bridges to Healing is reserved for the therapy funnel CTA only; general mentions use practiceUrl.
_comment_audio: r2BaseUrl is the public URL of the mayanas-professional-site R2 bucket — the single value that switches the player on. This is the r2.dev Public Development URL: rate-limited and uncached, which is fine for review. At launch, once DNS moves to Cloudflare, connect a custom domain such as audio.mayanageathers.com to the bucket and change this one value. audioPrefix is empty because the MP3s sit at the bucket root.
_comment_images: Photography and marks. A value may be a bare FILENAME (looked up in src/assets/img/, and skipped if not present yet) or a FULL URL, e.g. an R2 public URL, which is used as-is.
